escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
escalations.detail: Template injection allows arbitrary code execution via malformed AST nodes. An attacker can craft a template that bypasses safety checks and executes arbitrary JavaScript.
escalations.impact: Remote Code Execution if user-supplied templates are compiled
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker provides a crafted Handlebars template string to any endpoint that compiles user input; RCE results

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read
escalations.detail: The Vitest UI server does not validate incoming requests, allowing attackers on the same network to read arbitrary files and execute code. Dangerous in CI/CD pipelines or shared dev environments.
escalations.impact: Full filesystem disclosure + code execution if Vitest UI server is exposed
escalations.fix: npm update vitest to >=3.2.6; disable Vitest UI in CI
escalations.exploit_scenario: CI runner exposes Vitest UI; attacker on the same network reads .env, SSH keys, or other sensitive files

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution
escalations.detail: Multiple code-generation gadgets in protobufjs allow crafted .proto files or JSON schemas to execute arbitrary code during parsing/compilation. 10 total CVEs in this package.
escalations.impact: RCE if orchestrator processes untrusted .proto definitions or external gRPC services
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker provides a crafted .proto definition or JSON schema; code executes in the orchestrator process during parsing

findings.title: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md describes a completely different application with zero source traceability
findings.detail: 74 FRs in this spec describe a SQLite-backed feature-request/bug tracking application. Current Source/ is an in-memory work-item engine. Zero traceability links exist between this spec and the codebase.
findings.impact: Spec is either obsolete (misleading) or Source/ is entirely wrong implementation
findings.fix: Archive or supersede Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md with a deprecation notice pointing to the active spec; OR reconcile Source/ with the spec
findings.exploit_scenario: N/A — traceability/documentation failure, not a security exploit

findings.title: FR-dependency-search route missing — implemented test self-documents as failing
findings.detail: The search route is absent from app.ts and routes dir. The test file explicitly notes 'will FAIL until the route is implemented.'
findings.fix: Implement the search route per spec, or remove the test and close the FR

findings.title: Routes directly import store — bypasses service layer (CLAUDE.md architecture rule violation)
findings.detail: routes/workItems.ts, routes/workflow.ts, routes/intake.ts all import * as store from '../store/workItemStore'. This violates CLAUDE.md: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.'
findings.fix: Extract store access into a service layer; routes should call service functions only

findings.title: Traceability enforcer only checks most-recently-modified plan; 7 plans go unchecked + false-positive bug
findings.detail: Enforcer scans only the most-recently-modified plan (self-judging-workflow, 13 FRs). 7 other plans go unchecked. FR-\d+ regex also matches domain item IDs in seed descriptions (false positives).
findings.fix: Fix enforcer to scan all active plans; refine regex to require traceability comment context (e.g. '// Verifies: FR-\d+')
